snippet.title: Island Market Simulator: Prologue Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
After months of development, Island Market Simulator: Prologue is finally in your hands! 🎮

Dive into your tropical paradise, start building your market empire, and discover all the surprises waiting for you. We can't wait to see what you create! 🏪

Thanks to everyone who supported us along the way. Your adventure begins now! ⚡

The island is calling! 🌺💫

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3880680/Island_Market_Simulator_Prologue/
